Subject: Follow-up: Supplier intake & payment routing for HealthSpan pilot

Hi Lucy / Mark — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement and onboarding timing for the pilot: 

- Economic buyer: Mark Chou confirmed (thanks).
- Procurement gate: HealthSpan requires a vendor intake (vendor form + W-9) and SOC 2 evidence.
- Invoicing: AP expects a PO for net-30 invoices; AP email shown on call was invoices@healthspan.com but we asked to confirm owner.
- Timeline: you indicated a typical vendor-add + PO creation window of ~3–6 weeks once the packet is complete.

As next steps we propose: 
1) I will share our vendor packet + redacted SOC2 and a first-pass SOW for your legal/procurement to review (attached).
2) Could you confirm the AP contact name and whether HealthSpan needs us to be on any specific vendor portal?
3) If there are contract redline owners (legal procurement vs. business), please share names — that will help route the SOW.

Ben and Jonas are on copy to own the vendor packet + SOC2 sharing and to prepare a short PO-friendly invoice worksheet. Ben — can you attach the packet and the invoice worksheet for Lucy by EOD?

Thanks — looking forward to locking the onboarding window.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

From: Lucy Park <lucy.park@healthspan.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Supplier intake & payment routing for HealthSpan pilot

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement/AP side: 

- Vendor intake: please complete our vendor intake form (I will send the PDF). Procurement needs the W-9 and a redacted SOC2 (SSAE attestation redacted is fine).
- PO & invoice routing: AP uses invoices@healthspan.com for uploads and PO issuance. Primary AP contact is Nina Patel (nina.patel@healthspan.com). She will open the vendor record and issue the PO.
- Vendor portal: not required for us — we handle vendor records internally.
- Timeline: once procurement has the vendor packet + W-9, expect ~4 weeks for the vendor record and PO issuance (can be faster if procurement has existing relationships).

One ask: can you confirm whether Redwood can accept electronic invoices (PDF) and provide the remit-to details we should expect to see on the invoice? Also please include whether Redwood requires a purchase-order reference on invoices for payment.

I can share the vendor intake form in a separate email — will loop Nina if you want direct intake coordination.

Thanks,
Lucy Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead, HealthSpan
lucy.park@healthspan.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: HealthSpan vendor packet & invoice format (prep)

Priya / Jonas — internal checklist based on Lucy's reply: 

- Prepare vendor packet: include completed vendor intake (blanked where HealthSpan asks), redacted SOC2 PDF, W-9, and vendor contact sheet.
- Invoice worksheet: fill InvoiceRouting-worksheet.xlsx with our remit-to and bank / ACH details (we will capture net-30 payment terms and PO reference requirements).
- SOW: finalize SOW-Redwood-HealthSpan-v1.docx and mark a 5-business-day review window for their legal.
- Ask: confirm whether Redwood can accept PDF e-invoices (yes) and whether we need to include PO number on the invoice for AP matching (most customers require PO reference).

I'll attach the current vendor packet and a populated invoice worksheet. Priya — once Lucy confirms Nina is the owner, I recommend looping Nina directly and asking for the vendor intake PDF.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

- Redwood prefers PO reference on the invoice for AP matching; we can accept invoices without a PO but payment timelines are smoother with a PO.
- Attached: Redwood-Vendor-Packet.pdf (completed draft, signature page pending), SOW-Redwood-HealthSpan-v1.docx (draft), InvoiceRouting-worksheet.xlsx (remit & tax info).

Next steps and tentative timing: 
1) Nina / procurement: please confirm receipt and send the vendor intake PDF back with any additional required fields.
2) Redwood (Ben / Jonas): will provide the redacted SOC2 and finalize SOW redline within 48 hours of any legal comments.
3) Goal: vendor record + PO within 3–5 weeks after completed intake (we will do our part to accelerate).

DocuSign link for the signature-ready vendor packet: https://www.docusign.com/packet/abc123-placeholder
